So $S=100-\sum_{k=2}^{101}b_k$, and $S\equiv0\pmod 4$ iff the number of ones among the $100$ independent fair bits $b_2,\dots,b_{101}$ is $\equiv0\pmod4$. By the roots-of-unity filter this probability is $\frac14\cdot\frac{2^{100}+(1+i)^{100}+(1-i)^{100}}{2^{100}}=\frac14\cdot\frac{2^{100}-2\cdot2^{50}}{2^{100}}=\frac14-2^{-51}$.
